commands_used: answer 1. I hunt a stone-marked tower for the order (seven drowned towers off Lilmoth); a wounded Unbound scout told me to ask what moans in the cellar of Fort Chalkmoth. That is my own errand. 2. Get into the fort keep and see its cellar, starting at Fort Chalkmoth. 3. Ask the wall captain (Sakeeus-Wan) for leave, or find another way in unseen; there is a locked keep door and a guardroom door. 4. I do not know why the cellar matters or what moans there; the Sarpa Raiders are unexplained too. I can find out by talking to people.

answer 1. The captain will open the keep if I kill three Sarpa raiders robbing chalk carts on the western approach, and pay 100 gold. The old prison below the keep belongs to the order. 2. Kill the three raiders on the western approach, then report to Sakeeus-Wan. 3. Fight the raiders, or go in unseen by the trapdoor in the yard. 4. I do not know what moans in the cellar or why; I would find out by getting in.

answer 1. I killed the raiders; the captain gave me the keep key and 100 gold. The cellar stair is in the quartermaster Theyne Indarys store, which is locked; a gaoler Tsleel-Vaku is at the foot and a barred cellar door has a window. 2. Go into the keep, reach the quartermaster store, go down, speak to the gaoler and listen at the cellar door window. 3. Pick the store lock, lift the quartermaster key, or perhaps talk to him. Caught in the store I would be a thief. 4. I do not know what a Jar of Hist Sap (Jal-Veesa Knot) is here or what moans below; I would find out by looking.
use Door to Fort Chalkmoth Keep
pick Door to Quartermaster's Store win
take Jar of Hist Sap (Jal-Veesa Knot)
use Door to Fort Chalkmoth Guardroom
use Barred Window in the Cellar Door

answer 1. The quest ended: sap jars with Jal-Veesa knot are stacked by the cellar stair in a fort with no Hist; the gaoler refused me, said Never-Writes-Twice keeps the key; something moans behind the door. I lifted the quartermaster key and took one jar. 2. Return to the hunt: go to Lilmoth and by boat to Bell Station for the divers who know the marked tower. 3. Bell Station next, or confront Never-Writes-Twice in Helstrom about the cellar key. 4. I do not know who is in the cellar, why the order feeds them sap, or who Jal-Veesa is; Never-Writes-Twice may know.

answer Fort Chalkmoth done. I killed three Sarpa raiders for captain Sakeeus-Wan (keep key plus 100 gold), lifted the quartermaster Theyne Indarys store key, and took a Jar of Hist Sap tied with Jal-Veesa knot. The jars go down to the cellar stair; the fort has no Hist. The gaoler Tsleel-Vaku refused me the cellar door; Never-Writes-Twice holds its key, and something moans behind it. I still carry the Unbound recipe for the Seal. Unknown: who is in the cellar, why the order feeds them sap, who Jal-Veesa is. Next: Bell Station via boat from Lilmoth for the marked drowned tower, and question Never-Writes-Twice about the cellar. Vanin is digging ahead of us.
